title: Luistro: Defense ‘dragging’ presentation of evidence in Sara Duterte impeachment trial
summary: House lead prosecutor Rep. Gerville Luistro on Friday accused the defense team of “dragging” the presentation of its evidence in the impeachment trial against Vice President Sara Duterte.
